name: GoCardless
description: Get intelligent, context-aware guidance for building GoCardless payment integrations directly from Claude. The GoCardless MCP provides comprehensive knowledge of API endpoints, integration patterns, webhooks, and code samples across all supported languages. Use it to generate integration code, set up payment pages, handle recurring billing, and follow best practices for error handling and security.

_published_faq.name: How do I add GoCardless to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add GoCardless to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.gocardless.com/. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the GoCardless MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: GoCardless provides these MCP tools: integrate_with_gocardless and read_gocardless_resource.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to GoCardless?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to GoCardless in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
GoCardless requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
GoCardless is developed by GoCardless. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
